title: Cross-Domain Transfer with Particle Physics Foundation Models: From Jets to Neutrino Interactions
abstract: arXiv:2604.12364v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Future AI-based studies in particle physics will likely start from a foundation model to accelerate training and enhance sensitivity. As a step toward a general-purpose foundation model for particle physics, we investigate whether the OmniLearned and ParticleViT foundation models pretrained on diverse high-$Q^2$ simulated and real $pp$ and $ep$ collisions retain useful knowledge to a few-GeV fixed-target neutrino experiment. We process MINERvA neutrino--nucleus scattering events and evaluate pretrained models on two types of tasks: regression of available energy and binary classification of charged-current pion final states ($\mathrm{CC1\pi^{\pm}}$, $\mathrm{CCN\pi^{\pm}}$, and $\mathrm{CC1\pi^{0}}$). Pretrained OmniLearned and ParticleViT models outperform similarly sized models trained from scratch at the same compute budget, with the largest gains for OmniLearned on regression and for ParticleViT on classification. translated_title: 跨域迁移在粒子物理基础模型中的应用：从喷注到中微子相互作用
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.12364v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：未来基于人工智能的粒子物理研究很可能从基础模型开始，以加速训练并增强灵敏度。作为迈向通用粒子物理基础模型的一步，我们研究了在多样化高$Q^2$模拟和真实$pp$及$ep$碰撞上预训练的OmniLearned和ParticleViT基础模型，是否能保留对几GeV固定靶中微子实验有用的知识。我们处理了MINERvA中微子-核散射事件，并在两类任务上评估预训练模型：可用能量的回归和带电电流π介子终态的二分类（$\mathrm{CC1\pi^{\pm}}$、$\mathrm{CCN\pi^{\pm}}$和$\mathrm{CC1\pi^{0}}$）。预训练的OmniLearned和ParticleViT模型在相同计算预算下，优于从零训练的同规模模型，其中OmniLearned在回归任务上增益最大，ParticleViT在分类任务上增益最大。
tldr: 本文证明预训练于高能碰撞数据的粒子物理基础模型，在迁移到低能中微子实验任务时，能显著优于从零训练的模型，展示了跨域迁移的潜力。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that foundation models pretrained on high-energy collision data can significantly outperform from-scratch models when transferred to low-energy neutrino experiment tasks, showcasing the potential of cross-domain transfer.
